translations.literal: In the second year of Jingde, with a general amnesty, he was restored as Inner Regular Attendant of the Inner Palace Service; he then served as Shaanxi Bandit-Catching Inspector, captured more than a thousand men, and was changed to Inner Palace Honored Corps.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingde, with a general amnesty, he was restored as Inner Regular Attendant of the Inner Palace Service. He then served as Shaanxi Bandit-Catching Inspector, captured more than a thousand men, and was promoted to Inner Palace Honored Corps.

sentences.zh: 從朝陵，為行宮四面巡檢。

translations.literal: Accompanying the imperial tomb visit, he was made Four-Directions Inspector of the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: While accompanying the imperial tomb visit, he was made Four-Directions Inspector of the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 四年，宜州卒陳進為亂。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the Yizhou soldier Chen Jin rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the Yizhou soldier Chen Jin rebelled.

sentences.zh: 初，知州劉永規馭下嚴酷，課澄海卒伐木葺州廨，數不中程即杖之，至有率妻孥趣山林以采者，雖甚風雨，不停其役。

translations.literal: At first, prefect Liu Yonggui governed his subordinates with harsh severity. He set the Chenghai soldiers to cut timber to repair the prefectural offices; if the quota was not met even once they were beaten with the staff. Some led wives and children into the mountains to gather wood, and even in heavy wind and rain the labor was not halted.
translations.idiomatic: At first the prefect Liu Yonggui governed his subordinates with harsh severity. He set the Chenghai soldiers to cut timber to repair the prefectural offices, and if the quota was missed even once they were flogged. Some led wives and children into the mountains to gather wood, and even in heavy wind and rain the labor was not halted.

sentences.zh: 故進因眾怨，殺永規及監軍國鈞，擁判官盧成均為帥，據其城。

translations.literal: Therefore Jin, exploiting public resentment, killed Yonggui and Military Inspector Guo Jun, installed Judge Lu Chengjun as commander, and seized the city.
translations.idiomatic: Jin therefore exploited public resentment, killed Yonggui and Military Inspector Guo Jun, installed Judge Lu Chengjun as commander, and seized the city.

sentences.zh: 七月，奏至，詔東上閣門使忠州刺史曹利用、供備庫使賀州刺史張煦為廣南東、西路安撫使，如京副使張從古及繼能副之，虞部員外郎薛顏同勾當轉運事，發荊湖蘄黃州兵討之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the report reached court. An edict appointed Eastern Upper Gate Envoy and Prefect of Zhongzhou Cao Liyong and Provision Equipment Storehouse Commissioner and Prefect of Hezhou Zhang Xu as Pacification Commissioners for the Eastern and Western Guangnan routes; Rujing Deputy Commissioner Zhang Conggu and Jineng served as their deputies; Ministry of Works Outer Section Member Xue Yan jointly managed transport affairs; and troops from Jinghu, Qi, and Huang prefectures were mobilized to suppress the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the report reached court. An edict appointed Eastern Upper Gate Envoy and Prefect of Zhongzhou Cao Liyong and Provision Equipment Storehouse Commissioner and Prefect of Hezhou Zhang Xu as Pacification Commissioners for the Eastern and Western Guangnan routes, with Rujing Deputy Commissioner Zhang Conggu and Jineng as their deputies. Ministry of Works Outer Section Member Xue Yan jointly managed transport affairs, and troops from Jinghu, Qi, and Huang prefectures were mobilized to suppress the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 上語近臣曰：「番禺寶貨雄富，賊若募驍果，立謀主，沿流東下趣廣州，則為患深矣。

translations.literal: The emperor said to close ministers: "Panyu is rich in treasure and goods. If the rebels recruit fierce fighters, establish a chief strategist, and go downriver east toward Guangzhou, the harm will be grave.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to his close ministers: "Panyu is rich in treasure and goods. If the rebels recruit fierce fighters, establish a chief strategist, and go downriver east toward Guangzhou, the harm will be grave.

sentences.zh: 」遣內侍高品周文質使廣州，監屯兵，會鄰路巡檢使控要路，集東西海戰棹，扼端州峽口。

translations.literal: " He dispatched Inner Attendant Senior Attendant Zhou Wenzhi to Guangzhou to oversee garrison troops, ordered neighboring-route inspection commissioners to hold the key roads, gathered war boats from the eastern and western seas, and sealed the gorge at Duanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: " He dispatched Inner Attendant Senior Attendant Zhou Wenzhi to Guangzhou to oversee garrison troops, ordered neighboring-route inspection commissioners to hold the key roads, gathered war boats from the eastern and western seas, and sealed the gorge at Duanzhou.

sentences.zh: 賊悉眾來攻柳城縣，殿直韓明、許貴、郝惟和以所部兵千餘禦敵，明、貴死之，惟和僅以身免，成均奉宜州印遣使詣舒賁求赦罪。

translations.literal: The rebels mustered their full force to attack Liucheng County. Palace Guard Han Ming, Xu Gui, and Hao Weihe with more than a thousand men under their command met the enemy. Ming and Gui died in battle; Weihe barely escaped with his life. Chengjun, bearing the seal of Yizhou, sent an envoy to Shu Ben to seek pardon for their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels mustered their full force to attack Liucheng County. Palace Guard Han Ming, Xu Gui, and Hao Weihe met the enemy with more than a thousand men under their command. Ming and Gui died in battle; Weihe barely escaped with his life. Chengjun, bearing the seal of Yizhou, sent an envoy to Shu Ben to seek pardon for their crimes.

sentences.zh: 是夕，進復陷柳城，官軍退保象州。

translations.literal: That same night Jin again took Liucheng, and the government troops retreated to hold Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That same night Jin again took Liucheng, and the government troops retreated to hold Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 賊又寇懷遠軍，知軍殿直任吉與邕桂巡檢、殿直張崇寶、侍禁張守榮擊走之。

translations.literal: The rebels also raided Huaiyuan Army. Army Commander Palace Guard Ren Ji, together with Yong-Gui Inspection Commissioner and Palace Guard Zhang Chongbao and Palace Guard Zhang Shourong, drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels also raided Huaiyuan Army. Army Commander Palace Guard Ren Ji, together with Yong-Gui Inspection Commissioner Palace Guard Zhang Chongbao and Palace Guard Zhang Shourong, drove them off.

sentences.zh: 賊退而復集者累日，吉輩固守，屢與鬥，大獲其器甲。

translations.literal: The rebels withdrew and regathered for many days. Ji and the others held firm, fought repeatedly, and captured a great quantity of their armor.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels withdrew and regathered for many days. Ji and the others held firm, fought repeatedly, and captured a great quantity of their armor.

sentences.zh: 又攻天河砦，砦兵甚少，監軍奉職錢吉部分嚴整，一戰敗之。

translations.literal: They also attacked Tianhe Fort. The fort had very few troops, but Military Inspector Attendant-in-Service Qian Ji deployed them in strict order and defeated the enemy in a single battle.
translations.idiomatic: They also attacked Tianhe Fort. The fort had very few troops, but Military Inspector Attendant-in-Service Qian Ji deployed them in strict order and defeated the enemy in a single battle.

sentences.zh: 賊眾屢衄，頗潰去，眾心的攜貳，將棄宜州，以家屬之悼耄者五百人隕江中，率其眾裁三千趣柳、象，將入容管。

translations.literal: The rebel host suffered repeated setbacks and many fled. Morale wavered and hearts divided; they were about to abandon Yizhou. Five hundred elderly dependents drowned in the river. Jin led only three thousand men toward Liuzhou and Xiangzhou, intending to enter Rongguan.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel host suffered repeated setbacks and many fled. Morale wavered and hearts divided, and they were about to abandon Yizhou. Five hundred elderly dependents drowned in the river. Jin led only three thousand men toward Liuzhou and Xiangzhou, intending to enter Rongguan.

sentences.zh: 初至柳州，限江不能渡。

translations.literal: When they first reached Liuzhou, they were blocked by the river and could not cross.
translations.idiomatic: When they first reached Liuzhou, they were blocked by the river and could not cross.

sentences.zh: 知州王昱望賊遁走，城遂陷。

translations.literal: Prefect Wang Yu, seeing the rebels flee, abandoned the city, and it then fell.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Wang Yu, seeing the rebels flee, abandoned the city, and it then fell.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以詔書四十分揭要路，諭賊歸順者悉釋其罪。

translations.literal: The court posted forty copies of the edict at key roads, declaring that all who surrendered would be fully pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: The court posted forty copies of the edict at key roads, declaring that all who surrendered would be fully pardoned.

sentences.zh: 賊挈族居思順州，分兵攻象州。

translations.literal: The rebels brought their families to settle at Sixun Prefecture and sent detachments to attack Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels brought their families to settle at Sixun Prefecture and sent detachments to attack Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 利用命入內高班於德潤以千兵倍道襲逐，利用等繼至，遇賊武仙縣之李練鋪。

translations.literal: Liyong ordered Inner Attendant Senior Attendant Yu Derun with a thousand men to pursue by forced march. Liyong and the others followed, and met the rebels at Liliancup in Wuxian County.
translations.idiomatic: Liyong ordered Inner Attendant Senior Attendant Yu Derun with a thousand men to pursue by forced march. Liyong and the others followed and met the rebels at Liliancup in Wuxian County.

sentences.zh: 賊初不知覺，惟進率眾來拒，直犯前軍，前軍寄班侍班郭誌言麾騎士左右縱擊。

translations.literal: At first the rebels did not know what was happening. Only Jin led his force to resist, charging straight at the vanguard. Vanguard Attendant-in-Service Guo Zhiyan commanded the cavalry to strike left and right.
translations.idiomatic: At first the rebels did not know what was happening. Only Jin led his force to resist, charging straight at the vanguard. Vanguard Attendant-in-Service Guo Zhiyan commanded the cavalry to strike from both flanks.

sentences.zh: 賊衣順水甲、執標牌以進，飛矢攢鋒不能卻，前軍即持棹刀巨斧破其牌，史崇貴登山大呼曰：「賊走矣，急殺之！

translations.literal: The rebels wore stream-fighting armor and advanced holding shield standards. Flying arrows piled at their points but could not drive them back. The vanguard took boat-hooks and great axes and broke their shields. Shi Chonggui mounted the hill and shouted loudly: "The rebels flee—kill them quickly!
translations.idiomatic: The rebels wore armor suited to fighting with the current and advanced holding shield standards. Flying arrows piled at their points but could not drive them back. The vanguard took boat-hooks and great axes and broke their shields. Shi Chonggui mounted the hill and shouted: "The rebels flee—kill them quickly!

sentences.zh: 」賊心動，眾遂潰。

translations.literal: " The rebels' hearts wavered, and the host collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: " The rebels' hearts wavered, and the host collapsed.

sentences.zh: 逐北至象州城下，賊砦猶有據長竿瞰城中者，成均始挈其族以詔書來降，乃斬進並其黨，生擒賊帥六十餘人，斬首級、獲器甲戰馬甚眾。

translations.literal: They pursued them north to the walls of Xiangzhou. In the rebel camp there were still men on long poles overlooking the city. Chengjun finally brought his clan with the edict to surrender. Jin and his followers were then executed. More than sixty rebel chiefs were captured alive, and heads, armor, and war horses were taken in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: They pursued the rebels north to the walls of Xiangzhou. In the rebel camp there were still men on long poles overlooking the city. Chengjun finally brought his clan with the edict to surrender. Jin and his followers were then executed. More than sixty rebel chiefs were captured alive, and heads, armor, and war horses were taken in great numbers.

sentences.zh: 利用分兵捕餘寇，遣於德潤馳奏其事。

translations.literal: Liyong divided his forces to hunt down the remaining bandits and sent Yu Derun by express relay to report the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Liyong divided his forces to hunt down the remaining bandits and sent Yu Derun by express relay to report the affair.

sentences.zh: 授利用引進使，煦如京使，從古莊宅副使，繼能供備庫使，誌言供備庫使。

translations.literal: Liyong was appointed Introducing Commissioner; Xu was made Rujing Commissioner; Conggu was made Deputy Commissioner of the Estates Office; Jineng was made Provision Equipment Storehouse Commissioner; and Zhiyan was made Provision Equipment Storehouse Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liyong was appointed Introducing Commissioner; Xu was made Rujing Commissioner; Conggu was made Deputy Commissioner of the Estates Office; Jineng was made Provision Equipment Storehouse Commissioner; and Zhiyan was made Provision Equipment Storehouse Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 又以御前忠佐馬步軍副都軍頭郭全豐為都軍頭，領勤州刺史。

translations.literal: Imperial Loyal Assistant Cavalry and Infantry Deputy Chief Commander Guo Quanfeng was also made Chief Commander and appointed Concurrent Prefect of Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Loyal Assistant Cavalry and Infantry Deputy Chief Commander Guo Quanfeng was also made Chief Commander and appointed Concurrent Prefect of Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 歸遠軍士手殺進者李昊、劉宗、趙敏並補本軍都頭，張守榮為供奉官、閣門祗候，張崇寶、任吉並為供奉官，錢吉為右侍禁。

translations.literal: Li Hao, Liu Zong, and Zhao Min of Huaiyuan Army, who had personally killed Jin, were all appointed company chiefs of their army. Zhang Shourong was made Palace Attendant and Gate Usher; Zhang Chongbao and Ren Ji were both made Palace Attendants; and Qian Ji was made Right Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hao, Liu Zong, and Zhao Min of Huaiyuan Army, who had personally killed Jin, were all appointed company chiefs of their army. Zhang Shourong was made Palace Attendant and Gate Usher; Zhang Chongbao and Ren Ji were both made Palace Attendants; and Qian Ji was made Right Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 又以知象州大理寺丞何邴最有勞，優拜祠部員外郎，賜緋。

translations.literal: He Bing, Assistant Magistrate of the Court of Judicial Review and prefect of Xiangzhou, had rendered the greatest service and was specially promoted to Outer Section Member of the Ministry of Sacrificial Affairs and granted the crimson robe.
translations.idiomatic: He Bing, Assistant Magistrate of the Court of Judicial Review and prefect of Xiangzhou, had rendered the greatest service. He was specially promoted to Outer Section Member of the Ministry of Sacrificial Affairs and granted the crimson robe.

sentences.zh: 又賜邴三子知道、知古、知常出身，邴之親屬同扞寇者悉甄敘之。

translations.literal: He Bing's three sons, Zhidao, Zhigu, and Zhichang, were also granted initial office rank, and all his relatives who had fought the bandits were selected and promoted.
translations.idiomatic: He Bing's three sons, Zhidao, Zhigu, and Zhichang, were also granted initial office rank, and all his relatives who had fought the bandits were selected and promoted.

sentences.zh: 升象州為防禦使。

translations.literal: Xiangzhou was raised to Defense Commissioner status.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangzhou was raised to Defense Commissioner status.

sentences.zh: 初，賊攻象州，城在高丘上，素無井，閉壘之日，皆以乏水為慮。

translations.literal: When the rebels attacked Xiangzhou, the city stood on a high hill and had never had wells. From the day the walls were closed, all feared a shortage of water.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels attacked Xiangzhou, the city stood on a high hill and had never had wells. From the day the walls were closed, everyone feared a shortage of water.

sentences.zh: 賴天雨，停水將竭而雨復下，如是者兩月，汲之以濟。

translations.literal: They relied on heaven's rain. The pooled water was nearly exhausted when rain fell again; this happened for two months, and they drew on it to sustain themselves.
translations.idiomatic: They relied on heaven's rain. The pooled water was nearly exhausted when rain fell again. This happened for two months, and they drew on it to sustain themselves.

sentences.zh: 山中無烽候，每欲破賊，即禱於城西神祠，或見巨蟒吞龜，是日果有克獲，眾以為神靈助順之應。

translations.literal: There were no beacon towers in the mountains. Whenever they wished to defeat the bandits they prayed at the shrine west of the city. Sometimes they saw a great python swallow a turtle, and that very day they indeed won a victory. The people took this as a response of the spirits aiding the righteous cause.
translations.idiomatic: There were no beacon towers in the mountains. Whenever they wished to defeat the bandits they prayed at the shrine west of the city. Sometimes they saw a great python swallow a turtle, and that very day they indeed won a victory. The people took this as a sign that the spirits were aiding the righteous cause.

sentences.zh: 張守榮俄病瘴，遣尚醫馳往視之，未至而卒，贈如京使，錄其子官。

translations.literal: Zhang Shourong soon fell ill with miasma. An imperial physician was dispatched in haste to treat him, but before he arrived Shourong died. He was posthumously granted Rujing Commissioner, and his son was given office.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shourong soon fell ill with miasma. An imperial physician was dispatched in haste to treat him, but before he arrived Shourong died. He was posthumously granted Rujing Commissioner, and his son was given office.

sentences.zh: 十二月，餘寇悉平。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the remaining bandits were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the remaining bandits were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 東封，留繼能為京舊城內巡檢鈐轄，俄加東染院使。

translations.literal: During the Eastern Fengshan rites, Jineng was left as Inspector Controller of the old capital inner city and soon added Commissioner of the Eastern Dyeing Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: During the Eastern Fengshan rites, Jineng was left as Inspector Controller of the old capital inner city and was soon made Commissioner of the Eastern Dyeing Bureau as well.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符二年，入內都知李神祐等坐事悉罷，擢繼能入內內侍省副都知。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Inner Attendant-in-Chief Li Shenyou and others were all dismissed for their offenses, and Jineng was promoted to Deputy Chief of the Inner Palace Service.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Inner Attendant-in-Chief Li Shenyou and others were all dismissed for their offenses, and Jineng was promoted to Deputy Chief of the Inner Palace Service.

sentences.zh: 時宗室多召侍講說書，上嘉其勤學，令講誦日別給公膳，專遣繼能主之。

translations.literal: At the time many members of the imperial clan summoned lecturers and readers. The emperor praised their diligence in study and ordered separate public rations for each day of lecture and recitation, specially dispatching Jineng to manage the matter.
translations.idiomatic: At the time many members of the imperial clan summoned lecturers and readers. The emperor praised their diligence in study and ordered separate public rations for each day of lecture and recitation, specially dispatching Jineng to manage the matter.

sentences.zh: 俄又與內殿承製岑保正提點郡縣主諸院事。

translations.literal: Soon he was also, together with Inner Hall Manufacture Commissioner Cen Baozheng, put in charge of the establishments of princesses and commandery mistresses.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was also, together with Inner Hall Manufacture Commissioner Cen Baozheng, put in charge of the establishments of princesses and commandery mistresses.

sentences.zh: 三年，兼群牧都監。

translations.literal: In the third year he was concurrently made Grand Herd Director General.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was concurrently made Grand Herd Director General.

sentences.zh: 祀汾陰，留掌大內兼舊城內巡檢鈐轄，俄領會州刺史。

translations.literal: During the sacrifice at Fenyin he was left in charge of the inner palace and concurrently Inspector Controller of the old capital inner city, and soon appointed Concurrent Prefect of Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the sacrifice at Fenyin he was left in charge of the inner palace and concurrently Inspector Controller of the old capital inner city, and was soon appointed Concurrent Prefect of Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 謁太清宮，為天書扶侍都監。

translations.literal: On the visit to the Grand Supreme Palace he served as Attendant Director for the Heavenly Book escort.
translations.idiomatic: On the visit to the Grand Supreme Palace he served as Attendant Director for the Heavenly Book escort.

sentences.zh: 七年，以疾求解職，不許。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, on grounds of illness he requested to resign his post; permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on grounds of illness he requested to resign his post, but permission was not granted.

sentences.zh: 命為涇原儀渭、鎮戎軍兩路鈐轄。

translations.literal: He was ordered to serve as Controller of the two routes of Jingyuan-Yiwei and Zhenrong Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to serve as Controller of the two routes of Jingyuan-Yiwei and Zhenrong Army.

sentences.zh: 未幾，徙鄜延都鈐轄。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to Chief Controller of the Fuyan route.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to Chief Controller of the Fuyan route.

sentences.zh: 先是，內屬戶殺漢口者止罰孳畜，繼能則麗於常法，由是西人畏而不敢犯。

translations.literal: Previously, when inner subjects killed Han people the penalty was only a fine in livestock. Jineng applied the normal law, and from this the western peoples feared him and dared not offend.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, when inner subjects killed Han people the penalty had been only a fine in livestock. Jineng applied the normal law, and from this the western peoples feared him and dared not offend.

sentences.zh: 德明雖受朝命，而羌部不絕寇境。

translations.literal: Although Deming accepted the court's commission, Qiang tribes never ceased raiding the border.
translations.idiomatic: Although Deming accepted the court's commission, Qiang tribes never ceased raiding the border.

sentences.zh: 繼能日課卒截竹為簽，署字其上，且言以備將士記殺獲功狀，賊聞之甚懼。

translations.literal: Each day Jineng had soldiers cut bamboo slips, inscribe their names upon them, and say this was to prepare records for officers and soldiers to note kills and captures for merit reports. When the bandits heard of it they were greatly afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Each day Jineng had soldiers cut bamboo slips and inscribe their names upon them, saying this was to prepare records for officers and soldiers to note kills and captures for merit reports. When the bandits heard of it they were greatly afraid.

sentences.zh: 歸朝，復涖群牧。

translations.literal: On return to court he again oversaw the Grand Herd.
translations.idiomatic: On return to court he again oversaw the Grand Herd.

sentences.zh: 仁宗在儲宮，嘗親書一幅賜之。

translations.literal: When Renzong was crown prince he once personally wrote a scroll and bestowed it upon him.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong was crown prince he once personally wrote a scroll and bestowed it upon him.

sentences.zh: 繼能以聞，真宗亦為標題其末，人以為榮。

translations.literal: Jineng reported it to the throne, and Zhenzong also inscribed a title at its end. People regarded this as an honor.
translations.idiomatic: Jineng reported it to the throne, and Zhenzong also inscribed a title at its end. People regarded this as a great honor.

sentences.zh: 九年，坐前護修莊穆皇后陵摧陷，左授西染院使，掌往來國信。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, for his earlier oversight of repairs to Empress Zhuangmu's tomb when it collapsed, he was demoted to Commissioner of the Western Dyeing Bureau and put in charge of diplomatic correspondence.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, for his earlier oversight of repairs to Empress Zhuangmu's tomb when it collapsed, he was demoted to Commissioner of the Western Dyeing Bureau and put in charge of diplomatic correspondence.

sentences.zh: 天禧初，復西京左藏庫使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianxi he was restored as Western Capital Left Treasury Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Tianxi era he was restored as Western Capital Left Treasury Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 國信司吏陳誠者，頗巧黠，繼能欲援置群牧司，而誠先隸群牧，坐事停職。

translations.literal: Chen Cheng, a clerk in the Diplomatic Correspondence Office, was quite clever and cunning. Jineng wished to recommend and place him in the Grand Herd Office, but Cheng had previously belonged to the Grand Herd Office and had been suspended from office for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Cheng, a clerk in the Diplomatic Correspondence Office, was quite clever and cunning. Jineng wished to recommend and place him in the Grand Herd Office, but Cheng had previously belonged to the Grand Herd Office and had been suspended from office for an offense.

sentences.zh: 至是，群牧吏左宗抉其宿負，白製置使曹利用，故誠不遂所求。

translations.literal: At this time Grand Herd clerk Zuo Zong exposed his old debts and reported the matter to Commissioner Cao Liyong, so Cheng did not obtain what he sought.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Grand Herd clerk Zuo Zong exposed his old debts and reported the matter to Commissioner Cao Liyong, so Cheng did not obtain what he sought.

sentences.zh: 繼能怒宗之沮己，密遣親事卒偵宗。

translations.literal: Jineng, angry that Zuo had obstructed him, secretly dispatched personal attendants to spy on Zuo.
translations.idiomatic: Jineng, angry that Zuo had obstructed him, secretly dispatched personal attendants to spy on Zuo.

sentences.zh: 會宗弟元喪妻，宗嘗為假敦駿軍校馬送葬，及還，元抵飲肆與酒保相毆，係府中，而假馬之事未發。

translations.literal: It happened that Zuo's younger brother Yuan's wife died. Zuo had once borrowed a horse from a Dunjun army officer to escort the funeral. When Yuan returned he fought with a tavern keeper at a wine shop and was detained in the prefectural office, but the matter of the borrowed horse had not yet come to light.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Zuo's younger brother Yuan's wife died. Zuo had once borrowed a horse from a Dunjun army officer to escort the funeral. When Yuan returned he fought with a tavern keeper at a wine shop and was detained in the prefectural office, but the matter of the borrowed horse had not yet come to light.

sentences.zh: 誠即白繼能，請屬府中並劾其事。

translations.literal: Cheng immediately reported this to Jineng and asked to intervene at the prefectural office and jointly impeach the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng immediately reported this to Jineng and asked to intervene at the prefectural office and jointly impeach the affair.

sentences.zh: 知府樂黃目受屬，獄未就，為群牧副使楊崇勳所發，繼能坐罷內職，降授西京作坊使，出為邠寧鈐轄。

translations.literal: Prefect Le Huangmu accepted the intervention. Before the case was concluded it was exposed by Deputy Grand Herd Commissioner Yang Chongxun. Jineng was punished by removal from inner service, demoted to Western Capital Workshop Commissioner, and sent out as Controller at Binning.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Le Huangmu accepted the intervention. Before the case was concluded it was exposed by Deputy Grand Herd Commissioner Yang Chongxun. Jineng was removed from inner service, demoted to Western Capital Workshop Commissioner, and sent out as Controller at Binning.

sentences.zh: 繼能自陳不願外任，得掌瑞聖園，尋領往來國信所。

translations.literal: Jineng reported that he was unwilling to take an outer post and was allowed to manage Ruisheng Garden; soon he was put in charge of the Diplomatic Correspondence Office.
translations.idiomatic: Jineng reported that he was unwilling to take an outer post and was allowed to manage Ruisheng Garden. Soon he was put in charge of the Diplomatic Correspondence Office.

sentences.zh: 三年，復為西京左藏庫使、內侍右班副都知。

translations.literal: In the third year he was again made Western Capital Left Treasury Commissioner and Deputy Chief of the Right Corps of the Inner Service.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was again made Western Capital Left Treasury Commissioner and Deputy Chief of the Right Corps of the Inner Service.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷崇儀使，以衰老求解職，轉內園使，掌瓊林苑。

translations.literal: Before long he was promoted to Honored Ceremonial Commissioner. On grounds of old age he requested to resign his post and was transferred to Inner Garden Commissioner, managing Qionglin Park.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was promoted to Honored Ceremonial Commissioner. On grounds of old age he requested to resign his post and was transferred to Inner Garden Commissioner, managing Qionglin Park.

sentences.zh: 五年，卒，年六十五。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he died, aged sixty-five.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he died, at the age of sixty-five.

sentences.zh: 特贈汀州團練使，錄其子懷忠為大理寺丞，孫逖為三班奉職，遜為借職、春坊祗候。

translations.literal: He was specially posthumously granted Military Training Commissioner of Tingzhou. His son Huaizhong was given office as Assistant Magistrate of the Court of Judicial Review; his grandson Ti was made Sanban Attendant-in-Service; and Sun was made Borrowed Rank Attendant and Attendant of the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was specially posthumously granted Military Training Commissioner of Tingzhou. His son Huaizhong was given office as Assistant Magistrate of the Court of Judicial Review; his grandson Ti was made Sanban Attendant-in-Service; and Sun was made Borrowed Rank Attendant and Attendant of the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 繼能性沉密知兵，頗勇敢，喜讀書，然好治生。

translations.literal: Jineng was by nature deep and discreet, understood warfare, was quite brave, and loved reading, yet he was fond of making a livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Jineng was by nature deep and discreet, understood warfare, was quite brave, and loved reading, yet he was fond of making a livelihood.

sentences.zh: 晚年急於聚蓄，眾以此少之。

translations.literal: In his later years he was eager to accumulate wealth, and for this people looked down on him somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years he was eager to accumulate wealth, and for this people looked down on him somewhat.

sentences.zh: 何邴後歸朝，知磁州而卒。

translations.literal: He Bing later returned to court, governed Cizhou, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He Bing later returned to court, governed Cizhou, and died.

sentences.zh: 一子知崇裁十餘歲，特補太廟齋郎。

translations.literal: One son, Zhichong, was barely over ten years old and was specially granted the post of Taibiao Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: One son, Zhichong, was barely over ten years old and was specially granted the post of Taibiao Attendant.

sentences.zh: 又徙其侄平夷尉知古為滏陽尉。

translations.literal: His nephew Zhigu, magistrate of Pingyi, was also transferred to be magistrate of Fuyang.
translations.idiomatic: His nephew Zhigu, magistrate of Pingyi, was also transferred to be magistrate of Fuyang.

sentences.zh: 省郎無賞延之例，猶以城守勞，故甄錄焉。

translations.literal: Central ministry officials had no precedent for extending rewards to sons, yet because of the merit of holding the city they were selected and recorded anyway.
translations.idiomatic: Central ministry officials had no precedent for extending rewards to sons, yet because of the merit of holding the city they were selected and recorded anyway.

sentences.zh: 李順之亂，王師致討，與王繼恩同領招安捉賊事，遇賊，鬥學射山南。

translations.literal: In Li Shun's rebellion, the imperial army was sent to suppress it; together with Wang Jien he jointly commanded pacification and bandit-capture affairs; encountering rebels, he fought at Douxue south of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: During Li Shun's rebellion, when imperial forces were sent to suppress it, he shared command of the pacification campaign with Wang Jien. He met the rebels in battle at Douxue, south of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 又攻清水埧，破雙流砦，招降數萬眾，斬千餘級。

translations.literal: He again attacked Qingshui Dam, broke Shuangliu Stockade, induced tens of thousands to surrender, and beheaded more than a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: He also attacked Qingshui Dam, stormed Shuangliu Stockade, brought tens of thousands to surrender, and killed more than a thousand men.

sentences.zh: 順死，餘黨保險為寇，又與楊瓊先扼要路以邀之，擒斬萬餘人，獲器甲槍槊千餘。

translations.literal: When Shun died, the remaining partisans held fortified positions and raided as bandits; again, together with Yang Qiong, he first seized strategic passes to intercept them, capturing and beheading more than ten thousand men and obtaining more than a thousand sets of armor, spears, and pikes.
translations.idiomatic: After Shun died, his remaining followers held the mountain passes and continued to raid. Shaoqin and Yang Qiong seized the key routes ahead of them, capturing and killing more than ten thousand men and seizing more than a thousand sets of armor, spears, and pikes.

sentences.zh: 遣別將曹習領兵捕餘賊於安國鎮，斬三百級。

translations.literal: He dispatched a separate commander, Cao Xi, to lead troops in capturing remnant rebels at Anguo Town, beheading three hundred.
translations.idiomatic: He sent a subordinate commander, Cao Xi, with troops to hunt down the remaining rebels at Anguo Town, where three hundred were killed.

sentences.zh: 時嘉、眉二州賊尚擾城郭，又遣內殿崇班宿翰討之。

translations.literal: At the time rebels in Jia and Mei prefectures still disturbed cities and towns; he again dispatched Inner Hall Honored Corps attendant Su Han to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels in Jia and Mei prefectures were still harassing the towns, so he dispatched Inner Hall Honored Corps attendant Su Han to put them down.

sentences.zh: 兩川平，召還，深被褒勞。

translations.literal: When the Two Rivers were pacified, he was recalled and deeply rewarded and commended.
translations.idiomatic: When the Two Rivers region was pacified, he was recalled to court and richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 真宗嗣位，拜宮苑使，領愛州刺史，充入內副都知、修奉永熙陵都監，即復土，遂為陵使。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong succeeded to the throne, he was appointed Palace Park Commissioner and Concurrent Prefect of Aizhou, serving as Deputy Inner Attendant-in-Chief and Chief Overseer for the maintenance of the Yongxi Mausoleum; once the earth-returning rites were completed, he became Mausoleum Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhenzong succeeded to the throne, Shaoqin was appointed Palace Park Commissioner and Concurrent Prefect of Aizhou, and made Deputy Inner Attendant-in-Chief and Chief Overseer for the Yongxi Mausoleum. When the burial rites were completed, he remained as Mausoleum Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 景德二年，改皇城使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingde, he was changed to Imperial City Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Jingde era, he was made Imperial City Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 從幸河朔，命為車駕前後行宮四面都巡檢。

translations.literal: Accompanying the imperial progress to Hebei, he was appointed General Inspector on all four sides of the mobile palaces before and behind the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor toured Hebei, he was appointed General Inspector of the mobile palaces on all four sides of the imperial procession.

sentences.zh: 次澶淵，命領扈駕兵守河橋。

translations.literal: When encamped at Chanyuan, he was ordered to lead escort troops guarding the river bridge.
translations.idiomatic: When the court halted at Chanyuan, he was ordered to lead the imperial escort in guarding the river bridge.

sentences.zh: 三年，加昭宣使。

translations.literal: In the third year, he was promoted to Zhaoxuan Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was promoted to Zhaoxuan Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 朝諸陵，復為行宮巡檢。

translations.literal: When paying court at the various mausoleums, he again became Mobile Palace Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: During visits to the imperial mausoleums, he again served as Mobile Palace Inspector.

sentences.zh: 駐洛陽，命為皇城內外都巡檢。

translations.literal: When stationed at Luoyang, he was appointed General Inspector inside and outside the Imperial City.
translations.idiomatic: While the court was stationed at Luoyang, he was appointed General Inspector of the Imperial City, inside and out.

sentences.zh: 曆掌三班院、皇城儀鸞翰林司。

translations.literal: He successively managed the Three-Rank Bureau, the Imperial City Ceremonial Guard Office, and the Hanlin Office.
translations.idiomatic: He successively managed the Three-Rank Bureau, the Imperial City Ceremonial Guard Office, and the Hanlin Office.

sentences.zh: 卒，年五十六。

translations.literal: He died, aged fifty-six.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of fifty-six.

sentences.zh: 紹欽苛愎少恩，不為眾所附。

translations.literal: Shaoqin was harsh, obstinate, and sparing in grace; he won no attachment from the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoqin was harsh and obstinate, sparing in kindness, and won no loyalty from those around him.

sentences.zh: 太平興國中，江東有僧詣闕請修天台壽昌寺，且言寺成願焚身以報。

translations.literal: During Taiping Xingguo, a monk in Jiangdong came to court requesting repair of Tiantai Shouchang Temple, saying that when the temple was completed he wished to burn his body in gratitude.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taiping Xingguo reign, a monk from Jiangdong came to court asking permission to rebuild Tiantai Shouchang Temple, and declared that once the work was finished he would burn himself alive in gratitude.

sentences.zh: 太宗允其請，命紹欽往督營繕。

translations.literal: Taizong granted his request and ordered Shaoqin to go supervise construction and repair.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong granted the request and ordered Shaoqin to go and supervise the rebuilding.

sentences.zh: 既訖役，遽積薪於廷，請僧如願，僧言欲見至尊面謝，紹欽曰：「昨朝辭日，親奉德音，不煩致謝。

translations.literal: When the labor was finished, he suddenly piled firewood in the courtyard and asked the monk to fulfill his wish. The monk said he wished to see the August Person face to face to give thanks. Shaoqin said: "Yesterday when you took leave at court, you personally received His virtuous pronouncement — there is no need to give thanks.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was done, he suddenly piled firewood in the courtyard and told the monk to fulfill his vow. The monk said he wished to see the emperor face to face to give thanks. Shaoqin replied: "When you took leave at court yesterday, you received the emperor's gracious word in person. There is no need to thank him again.

sentences.zh: 」僧惴怖偃蹇，顧道俗望有救之者，紹欽即促令躋薪上，火既盛，僧欲投下，紹欽遣左右以叉抑按而焚之。

translations.literal: " The monk, fearful and hesitant, looked to clerics and laypeople hoping someone would save him. Shaoqin immediately pressed him to climb onto the firewood. When the fire was already blazing, the monk wished to jump down. Shaoqin dispatched attendants to restrain and press him down with forks and burn him.
translations.idiomatic: " The monk, terrified and balking, looked to the monks and lay followers around him, hoping someone would intervene. Shaoqin immediately forced him onto the pyre. Once the flames were high, the monk tried to jump down. Shaoqin had his attendants pin him with forks and burn him alive.

sentences.zh: 子承慶，至內殿承製。

translations.literal: His son Chengqing rose to Inner Hall Manufacture Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: His son Chengqing rose to the rank of Inner Hall Manufacture Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 石知顒，真定人。

translations.literal: Shi Zhiyong was a man of Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Zhiyong was a native of Zhending.

sentences.zh: 曾祖承渥，梁尚食使。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Chengwo was Liang Food Service Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Chengwo had served as Food Service Commissioner under the Liang.

sentences.zh: 祖守忠，晉內供奉官。

translations.literal: His grandfather Shouzhong was Jin Inner Attendant-in-Waiting.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Shouzhong had been an Inner Attendant-in-Waiting under the Jin.

sentences.zh: 父希鐸，高品。

translations.literal: His father Xiduo was a Senior Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xiduo held the rank of Senior Attendant.

sentences.zh: 知顒形貌甚偉，建隆中授內中高品。

translations.literal: Zhiyong's build was very imposing; in Jianlong he was appointed Senior Inner Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiyong was a man of imposing stature. In the Jianlong era he was appointed Senior Inner Attendant.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，改供奉官。

translations.literal: When Taizong took the throne, he was changed to Attendant-in-Waiting.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong acceded to the throne, he was made Attendant-in-Waiting.

sentences.zh: 雍熙中，諸將征幽薊，以知顒隨軍。

translations.literal: In Yongxi, when the generals campaigned against You and Ji, Zhiyong accompanied the army.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongxi reign, when the generals campaigned against You and Ji, Zhiyong accompanied the army.

sentences.zh: 歸，掌儀鸞司。

translations.literal: Upon return, he managed the Ceremonial Guard Office.
translations.idiomatic: After returning to court, he took charge of the Ceremonial Guard Office.

sentences.zh: 淳化中，明州初置市舶司，與蕃商貿易，命知顒往經制之。

translations.literal: In Chunhua, when Mingzhou first established the Maritime Trade Office to trade with foreign merchants, Zhiyong was ordered to go and oversee it.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chunhua reign, when Mingzhou first established a Maritime Trade Office for commerce with foreign merchants, Zhiyong was sent to organize and oversee it.

sentences.zh: 轉內殿崇班、親王諸宮都監。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Inner Hall Honored Corps and Director General of the Princes' Palaces.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Inner Hall Honored Corps and made Director General of the Princes' Palaces.

sentences.zh: 從王繼恩平蜀寇，就遷西京作坊副使。

translations.literal: Following Wang Jien in pacifying Shu rebels, he was promoted on the spot to Deputy Commissioner of the Western Capital Workshops.
translations.idiomatic: After joining Wang Jien in pacifying the Shu rebels, he was promoted on the spot to Deputy Commissioner of the Western Capital Workshops.

sentences.zh: 咸平初，遷正使、帶禦器械。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianping, he was promoted to Chief Commissioner and granted imperial arms to bear.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Xianping era, he was promoted to Chief Commissioner and granted the privilege of bearing imperial arms.

sentences.zh: 契丹犯邊，上北巡，命為天雄軍、澶州巡檢使，俄改德、博等州緣河巡檢使兼安撫，加領長州刺史。

translations.literal: When the Khitan violated the border and the emperor toured north, he was appointed Inspector of Tianxiong Army and Chuanzhou; soon he was changed to Inspector of De, Bo, and other prefectures along the river, concurrently Pacification Commissioner, and additionally appointed Concurrent Prefect of Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan raided the frontier and the emperor toured north, he was appointed Inspector of Tianxiong Army and Chuanzhou. Soon he was made Inspector of De, Bo, and other prefectures along the river, concurrently serving as Pacification Commissioner, with the additional title of Concurrent Prefect of Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年，戍鎮、定、高陽關三路，押大陣。

translations.literal: In the third year, he garrisoned the three routes of Zhen, Ding, and Gaoyang Pass and commanded the great array.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he garrisoned the three routes of Zhen, Ding, and Gaoyang Pass and commanded the main army.

sentences.zh: 是冬，改高陽關駐泊行營鈐轄。

translations.literal: That winter, he was changed to Controller of the encamped mobile headquarters at Gaoyang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he was made Controller of the encamped mobile headquarters at Gaoyang Pass.

sentences.zh: 歸朝，復掌親王諸宮事。

translations.literal: Upon returning to court, he again managed affairs of the Princes' Palaces.
translations.idiomatic: After returning to court, he again managed the affairs of the Princes' Palaces.

sentences.zh: 景德中，自京抵泗，遣徒治河堤，命總其役。

translations.literal: In Jingde, from the capital to Si, laborers were dispatched to repair river dikes, and he was ordered to oversee the work in total.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jingde reign, laborers were sent from the capital to Si to repair the river dikes, and he was ordered to oversee the entire project.

sentences.zh: 初計工累月，及是，浹日而畢。

translations.literal: At first the work was estimated to take months; at this juncture it was finished within ten days.
translations.idiomatic: The work had initially been estimated to take months, but this time it was finished within ten days.

sentences.zh: 上面加褒諭，賜白金千兩，授入內都知。

translations.literal: The emperor personally added commendation and instruction, bestowing one thousand taels of white gold and appointing him Inner Attendant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally commended him, bestowed one thousand taels of white gold, and appointed him Inner Attendant-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符初，遷內園使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong Xiangfu, he was promoted to Inner Garden Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Dazhong Xiangfu era, he was promoted to Inner Garden Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 俄以定內侍遷秩品第不當，為其列所誣，坐罷都知。

translations.literal: Soon, for fixing eunuch promotions in rank and grade improperly, he was slandered by his peers and punished by removal from Attendant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, for having improperly fixed the ranks and grades of eunuch promotions, he was denounced by his colleagues and removed from the post of Attendant-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 三年，為並、代州鈐轄，遷莊宅使，徙鎮、定、高陽關鈐轄。

translations.literal: In the third year, he was made Controller of Bing and Dai prefectures, promoted to Estates Commissioner, and transferred to Controller of Zhen, Ding, and Gaoyang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was made Controller of Bing and Dai prefectures, promoted to Estates Commissioner, and transferred to Controller of Zhen, Ding, and Gaoyang Pass.

sentences.zh: 四年，命與內殿崇班張繼能、供奉官侍其旭同修太祖神御殿。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he was ordered together with Inner Hall Honored Corps Zhang Jineng and Attendant-in-Waiting Shi Qixu to jointly repair the Spirit Imperial Hall of Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was ordered, together with Inner Hall Honored Corps Zhang Jineng and Attendant-in-Waiting Shi Qixu, to repair the Spirit Imperial Hall of Taizu.

sentences.zh: 上封求覲闕下，復掌群牧司、三班院、親王諸宮事。

translations.literal: He memorialized the throne requesting audience at court and again managed the Grand Herd Office, the Three-Rank Bureau, and affairs of the Princes' Palaces.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized the throne requesting an audience at court and again took charge of the Grand Herd Office, the Three-Rank Bureau, and the affairs of the Princes' Palaces.

sentences.zh: 天禧二年，為並、代州鈐轄兼管勾麟府路軍馬事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianxi, he was made Controller of Bing and Dai prefectures, concurrently managing military horse affairs on the Lin-Fu route.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Tianxi era, he was made Controller of Bing and Dai prefectures, concurrently overseeing military horse affairs on the Lin-Fu route.

sentences.zh: 三年，卒，年六十九。

translations.literal: In the third year, he died, aged sixty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he died, at the age of sixty-nine.

sentences.zh: 孫全彬。

translations.literal: Grandson Quan Bin.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson was Quan Bin.

sentences.zh: 全彬字長卿，以知顒奏補入內小黃門，累遷西頭供奉官。

translations.literal: Quan Bin, courtesy name Changqing, through Zhiyong's memorial was granted entry as Junior Yellow Gate and was gradually promoted to Western Attendant-in-Waiting.
translations.idiomatic: Quan Bin, courtesy name Changqing, entered palace service as Junior Yellow Gate through Zhiyong's recommendation and was gradually promoted to Western Attendant-in-Waiting.

sentences.zh: 仁宗使致香幣於南海，密詔察所過州縣吏治民俗，還，具以對，帝以為忠謹。

translations.literal: Renzong sent him to deliver incense and silks to the Southern Sea, with a secret edict to inspect local governance and popular customs in every prefecture and county passed through. Upon return he reported fully; the emperor regarded him as loyal and careful.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong sent him to deliver incense and silks to the Southern Sea, with a secret edict to inspect the governance and customs of every prefecture and county along the route. When he returned and reported in full, the emperor judged him loyal and careful.

sentences.zh: 陝右群盜殺鳳州巡檢，遣往擒滅之。

translations.literal: Bandits in western Shaanxi killed the Fengzhou inspector; he was dispatched to capture and destroy them.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits in western Shaanxi killed the Fengzhou inspector, he was dispatched to capture and destroy them.

sentences.zh: 元昊叛，全彬監鄜州兵救延州，解圍去。

translations.literal: When Yuanhao rebelled, Quan Bin supervised Yan prefecture troops to relieve Yanzhou; the siege was lifted and the enemy departed.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuanhao rebelled, Quan Bin supervised Yanzhou troops in the relief of Yanzhou; the siege was lifted and the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 經略使明鎬言其勇略善將，得邊人情，除並、代州都監，加內侍押班。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Ming Hao stated that he was brave and strategic, skilled in commanding, and understood border sentiment; he was appointed Director General of Bing and Dai prefectures and added Inner Attendant Escort Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Ming Hao reported that Quan Bin was brave and strategic, skilled at command, and understood the border peoples. He was appointed Director General of Bing and Dai prefectures and made Inner Attendant Escort Chief.

sentences.zh: 進鈐轄，徙鄜延，還，為押班。

translations.literal: He advanced to Controller, was transferred to the Fuyan route, returned, and became Escort Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Controller, transferred to the Fuyan route, and after returning to court became Escort Chief.

sentences.zh: 儂智高寇廣南，以為湖南、江西路安撫副使。

translations.literal: When Nong Zhigao raided Guangnan, he was made Deputy Pacification Commissioner of the Hunan and Jiangxi routes.
translations.idiomatic: When Nong Zhigao raided Guangnan, Quan Bin was made Deputy Pacification Commissioner of the Hunan and Jiangxi routes.

sentences.zh: 出桂林，請於宣撫使狄青，願獨當一隊以自效。

translations.literal: Departing Guilin, he requested of Pacification Commissioner Di Qing that he be allowed to take a force alone to prove himself.
translations.idiomatic: After leaving Guilin, he asked Pacification Commissioner Di Qing to let him lead a force on his own and prove his worth.

sentences.zh: 於是使將左方兵，力戰於邕州。

translations.literal: Thereupon he was made to command the left wing troops and fought fiercely at Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was then put in command of the left wing and fought fiercely at Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 南方平，領綿州防禦使。

translations.literal: When the south was pacified, he concurrently held Military Defense Commissioner of Mianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the south was pacified, he was granted the concurrent title of Military Defense Commissioner of Mianzhou.

sentences.zh: 張貴妃居寧華殿閣，命全彬提舉。

translations.literal: Consort Zhang resided at Ninghua Hall Pavilion; Quan Bin was ordered to oversee it.
translations.idiomatic: When Consort Zhang took up residence in Ninghua Hall Pavilion, Quan Bin was ordered to oversee it.

sentences.zh: 妃薨，治喪過製，皆劉沆、王洙與全彬共為之。

translations.literal: When the consort died, funeral observances exceeded proper rites; all were jointly handled by Liu Hang, Wang Shu, and Quan Bin.
translations.idiomatic: When the consort died, the funeral arrangements exceeded proper ritual. Liu Hang, Wang Shu, and Quan Bin jointly oversaw them all.

sentences.zh: 數月，進宮苑使、利州觀察使，給兩使留後奉。

translations.literal: Within months, he was promoted to Palace Park Commissioner and Observation Commissioner of Lizhou, granted the stipend of two commissioners' acting governors.
translations.idiomatic: Within months he was promoted to Palace Park Commissioner and Observation Commissioner of Lizhou, with the stipend of an acting governor of two commissions.

sentences.zh: 俄為入內副都知，知制誥劉敞封還詞命，居三月，復授之。

translations.literal: Soon he was made Deputy Inner Attendant-in-Chief; Document Drafting Academician Liu Chang returned the appointment sealed; after three months it was granted again.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made Deputy Inner Attendant-in-Chief. Document Drafting Academician Liu Chang returned the appointment sealed in protest, but after three months the appointment was granted again.

sentences.zh: 轉領信武軍留後，為永昭陵鈐轄。

translations.literal: He was transferred to concurrently Acting Governor of Xinquan Army and made Controller of the Yongzhao Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Acting Governor of Xinquan Army and made Controller of the Yongzhao Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 時去永定復土四十二年，有司多亡其籍，全彬以心計辦治。

translations.literal: At the time it was forty-two years since the earth-returning at Yongding; many departments had lost their records; Quan Bin handled it through his own careful planning.
translations.idiomatic: It was then forty-two years since the earth-returning rites at Yongding, and many offices had lost their records. Quan Bin managed the affair through his own careful planning.

sentences.zh: 遷福延宮使，提點奉先院。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Fuyan Palace Commissioner and Supervisor of the Imperial Ancestral Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Fuyan Palace Commissioner and made Supervisor of the Imperial Ancestral Hall.

sentences.zh: 熙寧中，卒，年七十六。

translations.literal: In Xining, he died, aged seventy-six.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xining reign he died, at the age of seventy-six.

sentences.zh: 贈太尉、定武軍節度使，諡曰恭僖。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Grand Commandant and Military Governor of Dingwu Army; his posthumous title was Gongxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the titles of Grand Commandant and Military Governor of Dingwu Army, with the posthumous name Gongxi.

sentences.zh: 鄧守恩，并州人。

translations.literal: Deng Shouen was a man of Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Shouen was a native of Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十歲以黃門事太宗。

translations.literal: At ten years of age he entered Yellow Gate service under Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: At the age of ten he entered palace service as a Yellow Gate attendant under Taizong.

sentences.zh: 淳化中，盜起成都，從王繼恩往討之。

translations.literal: In Chunhua, when bandits rose at Chengdu, he followed Wang Jien to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chunhua reign, when bandits rose at Chengdu, he followed Wang Jien to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 至道初，就護西蜀屯兵。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhidao, he went to oversee garrison troops in western Shu.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhidao era, he was sent to oversee the garrison troops in western Shu.

sentences.zh: 咸平初，為入內高班。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianping, he was made Senior Inner Attendant Corps.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Xianping era, he was made Senior Inner Attendant Corps.

sentences.zh: 契丹入寇，命石保吉為鎮、定都部署，以守恩為都監。

translations.literal: When the Khitan invaded, Shi Baoji was ordered as Chief Deployer of Zhen and Ding; Shouen was made Director General.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan invaded, Shi Baoji was appointed Chief Deployer of Zhen and Ding, with Shouen as his Director General.

sentences.zh: 逾年，入掌騏驥院。

translations.literal: After a year, he entered to manage the Qiji Stud.
translations.idiomatic: After a year he returned to court to manage the Qiji Stud.

sentences.zh: 會龍騎叛卒剽劫環、慶，遣守恩擒翦之。

translations.literal: When Dragon Cavalry mutinous soldiers looted Huan and Qing, Shouen was dispatched to capture and eliminate them.
translations.idiomatic: When mutinous Dragon Cavalry soldiers looted Huan and Qing, Shouen was dispatched to capture and destroy them.

sentences.zh: 景德初，為澶、濮都巡檢。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jingde, he was made General Inspector of Chen and Pu.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jingde era, he was made General Inspector of Chen and Pu.

sentences.zh: 又使環、慶及戎、瀘等州巡察邊事。

translations.literal: He was again sent to Huan, Qing, and Rong, Lu, and other prefectures to inspect border affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was again sent to inspect border affairs in Huan, Qing, Rong, Lu, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符初，按獄於濮州，雪冤人十餘。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong Xiangfu, he conducted judicial review at Puzhou and exonerated more than ten wronged persons.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Dazhong Xiangfu era, he conducted a judicial review at Puzhou and cleared more than ten wrongfully convicted men.

sentences.zh: 預監修玉清昭應宮、會靈觀。

translations.literal: He participated in supervising construction of Yuqing Zhaoying Palace and Huiling Temple.
translations.idiomatic: He helped supervise the construction of Yuqing Zhaoying Palace and Huiling Temple.

sentences.zh: 七年，又兼修真遊殿、景靈宮。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he additionally supervised Zhenzhen You Hall and Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he additionally supervised Zhenzhen You Hall and Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 累遷入內高品、供奉官。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Senior Inner Attendant and Attendant-in-Waiting.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted, rising to Senior Inner Attendant and Attendant-in-Waiting.

sentences.zh: 宮成，遷內殿承製。

translations.literal: When the palace was completed, he was promoted to Inner Hall Manufacture Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When the palace was completed, he was promoted to Inner Hall Manufacture Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八年，預修大內，改西京作坊副使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he participated in repairing the Inner Palace and was changed to Deputy Commissioner of the Western Capital Workshops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he took part in repairing the Inner Palace and was made Deputy Commissioner of the Western Capital Workshops.

sentences.zh: 九年，營造皆畢，授東染院使，充會靈觀都監。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, when all construction was finished, he was appointed Eastern Dyeing Bureau Commissioner and served as Chief Overseer of Huiling Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, when all construction was finished, he was appointed Eastern Dyeing Bureau Commissioner and made Chief Overseer of Huiling Temple.

sentences.zh: 天禧二年，掌軍頭引見司，又修祥源觀成，遷崇儀使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianxi, he managed the Army Head Presentation Office; also completed repair of Xiangyuan Temple and was promoted to Honored Ceremonial Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Tianxi era he managed the Army Head Presentation Office, completed the repair of Xiangyuan Temple, and was promoted to Honored Ceremonial Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三年，授入內押班。

translations.literal: In the third year, he was appointed Inner Attendant Escort Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was appointed Inner Attendant Escort Chief.

sentences.zh: 河決滑州，命為修河鈐轄。

translations.literal: When the Yellow River breached at Huazhou, he was appointed Controller of river repair.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yellow River breached at Huazhou, he was appointed Controller of the river-repair project.

sentences.zh: 郊祀，召為行宮使，改如京使，復還本任。

translations.literal: During the suburban sacrifice, he was summoned as Mobile Palace Commissioner, changed to Rujing Commissioner, and then restored to his original post.
translations.idiomatic: During the suburban sacrifice he was summoned as Mobile Palace Commissioner, briefly made Rujing Commissioner, and then restored to his original post.

sentences.zh: 四年春，河復故道，遷文思院使。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, the river returned to its old channel; he was promoted to Commissioner of the Literary Thinking Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year the river returned to its old course, and he was promoted to Commissioner of the Literary Thinking Hall.

sentences.zh: 歸朝，加領昭州刺史。

translations.literal: Upon returning to court, he was additionally appointed Concurrent Prefect of Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: After returning to court, he was additionally appointed Concurrent Prefect of Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 是秋，掌皇城、國信二司，整肅禁衛，遷入內副都知。

translations.literal: That autumn, he managed the Imperial City and Diplomatic Correspondence offices, tightened palace guards, and was promoted to Deputy Inner Attendant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he took charge of the Imperial City and Diplomatic Correspondence offices, tightened the palace guard, and was promoted to Deputy Inner Attendant-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 會建天章閣，命領其事。

translations.literal: When the Tianzhang Pavilion was being built, he was ordered to oversee the project.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tianzhang Pavilion was being built, he was ordered to oversee the project.

sentences.zh: 又勾當資善堂兼太子左右春坊司。

translations.literal: He also managed Zishan Hall affairs and the Crown Prince's Left and Right Spring Palace offices.
translations.idiomatic: He also managed Zishan Hall and the Crown Prince's Left and Right Spring Palace offices.

sentences.zh: 守恩長七尺餘，狀貌甚偉，涖事幹敏，以強果稱於時。

translations.literal: Shouen was more than seven feet tall; his appearance was very imposing; in handling affairs he was capable and quick; he was known in his time for strength and resolve.
translations.idiomatic: Shouen stood more than seven feet tall, with a very imposing appearance. In office he was capable and quick, and was known in his day for forcefulness and resolve.

sentences.zh: 五年，卒，年四十八。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he died, aged forty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he died, at the age of forty-eight.

sentences.zh: 贈淄州防禦使。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Military Defense Commissioner of Zizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the title of Military Defense Commissioner of Zizhou.

sentences.zh: 錄其子官。

translations.literal: His son was given office.
translations.idiomatic: His son was granted an official appointment.
